known_limitations: Backend-specific tracing may require a source adapter before Bering ingestion; EXPECTED means that the static collection path is complete, not that runtime trace quality is proven.
DECLARED instrumentation and propagation remain runtime assumptions until matching traces are observed.
Procrustes evaluates static eligibility only; Bering must validate runtime evidence, coverage, and signal quality.

trace_sources.collection: Jaeger /api/traces for the selected services, scenario, and collection window
